newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Park opens hotel, card club.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Park opens hotel, card club.

text.p: Hollywood Park Inc said on Friday that its hotel and card club in a suburb of Los Angeles, the Crystal Park, is now open under the management of Compton Entertainment Inc.

Hollywood Park and its partners have invested $26 million in the property and negotiated a five-year lease with Compton Entetainment. The Radisson hotel chain will market the property through its 300 hotel and sales offices.
California law precludes Hollywood Park, as a publicly traded company, from operating a card club at any location other than its Hollywood Park horse racing track.

"By acquiring and developing gaming and entertainment facilities and enhancing their return through value-added asset management, we've expanded our operations to become a diversified national entertainment and gaming company," R.D. Hubbard, chief executive officer, said in a statement.

Crystal Park has 50,000 square feet of gambling with 110 table games offering seven-card stud, 13-card poker, L.A. blackjack, draw poker and others. Seventy tables are devoted to such Asian games as pai gow poker, super pan 9 and pai gow. A nine-story hotel has 282 rooms and 41 suites.
